text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Haru
Urara...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look at all those plushies in the
machine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara points toward a claw machine
filled
with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, they look so soft and huggable! I just wanna squeeeze 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara stares longingly at the
plushies with
sparkles in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: ――それなら俺が取ってあげる！
――それなら私が取ってあげる！

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll stand next to you and cheer
you on! You
can do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
